section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single study of 322 female university (college) students examining relationships among consideration of cosmetic surgery, media influence (SATAQ-3), body appreciation (BAS), and demographics including BMI and age. Results indicated consideration of cosmetic surgery was positively associated with media influence and negatively associated with body appreciation, age, and BMI; regression results showed media influence, lower body appreciation, and lower BMI predicted consideration of cosmetic surgery.
section_summary.evidence_source: Summary derived from the abstract: "The current study examined... In total, 322 female university students... Bivariate correlations showed... negatively correlated with BAS scores, age, and body mass index (BMI). A multiple regression showed that the only significant predictors... greater media influence, less body appreciation, and lower BMI."
